summary: Execution-aware calibration preserves printed and remaining allocations, bounds two-stock volume, and protects version-4 experiment history.
notes: Calibrate and print either two-stock leg first. Once the companion starts, its entire allocation remains fixed; started fill allocations remain fixed per well.

Two-stock integer allocation reserves unrelated reagents and started fill within the available volume. Previews, concentration exports and well tooltips report projected actual mixture concentrations.

Calibration can continue without a fill stock, with reported shortfalls. Stale previews require review again; Refresh / recover validates saved execution, and one guarded save retry preserves the original experiment identity.

Automatic stock calculations preserve editing focus, cancel obsolete work, and display progress in a fixed footer. Settings scroll while experiment actions remain accessible; low-count well shading is corrected.

Execution-calibration documents use version 4; versions 1 through 3 remain readable. Online/offline installation requires both execution_calibrations_v4 and execution_volume_budget_v1, including the target's rollback floor.

No historical published release is a qualified rollback target. Continue on this version, use Reopen Current Version when offered, or obtain a qualified compatible release-aware bundle through the protected updater. Never downgrade experiment documents, restore older progress, remove compatibility declarations, or manually switch production code.
Legacy clients must use the pinned rc.11 bridge before this schema-v2 release. The stable and legacy release-index pointers remain unchanged. No direct legacy bridge is authorized by this release.

Release-aware offline packaging supports RC manifests and verifies the captured bundle commit. Firmware bytes, device protocol, shared dependencies and canonical machine-data schema are unchanged. Physical qualification is not implied by software validation.
